Product Details: AIPL Glow in the Dark Tape is designed for enhanced night-time visibility and creative decorative use. Made with durable phosphorescent material, this tape absorbs light and emits a bright green glow in the dark, making it perfect for safety markings on stairs, emergency exits, and low-light areas. Available in two practical sizes (20MM x 16.4 Feet and 50MM x 6.56 Feet), it is also a great addition to theater sets, DIY décor, or guiding paths in homes and buildings. The adhesive backing ensures a secure fit on most surfaces like wood, metal, plastic, and tiles. Whether you’re highlighting hazardous edges or adding glowing effects to your room, AIPL’s Glow Tape is the ideal choice.
